text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Regular exercise, such as walking or swimming, keeps your body strong and helps you feel happier. Getting enough sleep is also important, because it gives you energy for the next day. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and spend time on hobbies you enjoy. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance so that you have time to relax as well as work.
